description: FROGGYLAND GOA Froggyland Goa is a vibrant and family-friendly water park located in the Nuvem area of South Goa. Known as one of the largest and most exciting amusement water parks in the region, Froggyland offers a refreshing break from Goa’s beaches and nightlife. The park is designed to provide entertainment for visitors of all age groups, making it a favorite destination for families, school groups, and adventure seekers. FROGGYLAND IN GOA – A PERFECT FAMILY DAY OUT When it comes to water-based fun in Goa, Froggyland in Goa stands out with its extensive list of attractions. Located just 15 km from Margao, it’s conveniently accessible from both South and North Goa. The park features a wide range of water activities including family slides, lazy rivers, rain dance zones, and kids’ pools. Some of the key attractions include: Wave Pool Lazy River Rain Dance Floor Tube Slides Body Slides Play Area for Children FROGGYLAND - THE WATER WORLD RIDES Froggyland – The Water World Rides offer a thrilling mix of excitement and fun. The water rides are designed to cater to different age groups and thrill levels. Here are some of the most popular rides: Family Multilane Slide – Perfect for group races Wave Pool – Simulates ocean waves in a safe environment Lazy River Ride – A peaceful float around the park Cyclone Ride – For adrenaline junkies Rain Dance with DJ – Dance your heart out under a waterfall Mushroom Umbrella Fountain – Fun for the little ones The well-maintained rides ensure safety while maximizing fun. Trained lifeguards are always on duty. FROGGYLAND - THE WATER WORLD TICKETS Entry to the park is ticketed, and prices vary depending on the day of the week, special events, and age categories. Here’s a rough breakdown: Adults: ₹500–₹600 (subject to change) Children: ₹300–₹400 Group Discounts: Available for schools, colleges, and corporates Froggyland – The Water World Tickets can be purchased online through ticketing platforms or directly at the gate. Combo packages that include meals or activities like kayaking and zorbing are also offered on occasion. FROGGY LAND – ACTIVITIES BEYOND WATER Beyond its iconic slides and pools, Froggy Land also features a range of other activities: Zorbing Ball Kayaking Pond Bungee Trampoline Rope Climbing Ziplining (on special event days) There are also clean changing rooms, locker facilities, and a well-stocked food court serving snacks and local Goan delicacies. GOA WATER PARK EXPERIENCE AT FROGGYLAND Looking for a memorable Goa water park experience? Froggyland delivers just that. Unlike other attractions focused solely on beach activities, Froggyland combines the thrill of water sports with theme park entertainment, making it a standout destination in Goa. Whether you're a tourist or a local, a day spent at Froggyland is filled with fun, laughter, and adventure. FROGGYLAND ENTRY FEE Planning your visit to Froggyland? Understanding the Froggyland entry fee structure helps you plan better. The ticket price includes access to all major water rides and facilities. General Admission: ₹500 to ₹600 for adults Child Tickets: ₹300 to ₹400 Special Discounts: Group bookings and school trips FROGGYLAND GOA TIMINGS The official Froggyland Goa timings are from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, every day. It's advisable to reach early, especially on weekends and holidays, to make the most out of your visit. Rain dance and some rides may operate on specific time slots. FROGGYLAND- THE WATER WORLD REVIEWS Froggyland Reviews are mostly positive, with guests praising its cleanliness, fun rides, and family-friendly environment. Many reviews highlight the helpful staff, safe environment, and good value for money. Visitors especially enjoy the wave pool, rain dance area, and children's play zone. HOW TO REACH FROGGYLAND GOA Froggyland is located in Nuvem, South Goa, easily accessible by various modes of transport: By Car/Taxi: A 25-minute drive from Margao and around 45 minutes from Panjim. By Public Bus: Buses from Margao and Panjim stop at Nuvem. From there, take a short rickshaw or taxi ride. By Two-Wheeler: Renting a scooter or bike is a great way to explore Goa and get to Froggyland. FROGGYLAND NEARBY ATTRACTIONS After enjoying your time at Froggyland, you can explore nearby attractions such as: Margao City – Explore Goan markets and colonial architecture. Colva Beach – A serene and less-crowded beach ideal for sunset views. Big Foot Loutolim – A cultural and heritage museum just 10 minutes away. Mother of God Church – A historic church in the Nuvem region. Whether you're looking for heart-pounding rides or just want to cool off on a sunny Goan afternoon, Froggyland Goa is the place to be. With exciting attractions, reasonable pricing, and excellent facilities, Froggyland ensures a day full of splashes, smiles, and unforgettable memories for everyone.

Respect for other guests and staff is mandatory; aggressive conduct will not be tolerated.

Froggyland is located in Nuvem, South Goa, easily accessible from both Margao and Panjim.

What are the Froggyland Goa timings?

The park is open daily from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

What is the Froggyland entry fee?

The ticket price ranges from ₹500 to ₹600 for adults and ₹300 to ₹400 for children.

Are food and locker facilities available at Froggyland?

Yes, there are clean changing rooms, locker rentals, and a food court with local snacks and drinks.

Is Froggyland suitable for young children?

Absolutely! There are kid-friendly slides, a mushroom fountain, and safe splash areas.

Can I buy Froggyland tickets online?

Yes, tickets are available online and at the entrance.

Are there group discounts available at Froggyland?

Yes, schools, colleges, and corporate groups can avail of discounted group rates.
